view.scene_description: A modern, brightly lit interior space featuring a central spiral bookshelf tower illuminated by LED lights. Large windows dominate the background, revealing an urban view. A red spiral staircase curves on the left. People are present, some walking, others seated at tables. The floor is polished, reflecting light and surroundings.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf tower
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical structure with multiple circular shelves, each holding books. It is illuminated from within by glowing white rings. Located centrally, it stands on a round wooden base. Its metallic surface reflects ambient light. No visible mounting hardware.

objects.label: red spiral staircase
objects.observation: A curved staircase with a bold red railing and steps, positioned on the left side of the frame. It ascends toward the upper level. The structure appears freestanding but integrated into the architecture. Its color contrasts sharply with the neutral tones of the room.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Floor-to-ceiling glass panes covering the right and rear walls, offering a bright, slightly overexposed view of buildings outside. They allow ample natural light into the space. Some window frames are visible. No visible supports for the glass panels.

objects.label: person walking
objects.observation: An individual in dark clothing walking from right to left near the center foreground. Their motion is captured mid-stride. They are partially obscuring a table behind them. No visible support or contact beyond their own feet on the floor.

objects.label: seated people
objects.observation: Two individuals sitting at a table on the right side, near the windows. One wears a white shirt, the other darker clothing. They appear engaged in conversation or reading. Their chairs are metal-framed with black seats. No visible supports or attachments beyond the chairs' legs on the floor.

objects.label: metal bar stools
objects.observation: Several high-backed stools with metal legs and black seats arranged around the base of the bookshelf tower. They are positioned for seating at the counter. Their legs make contact with the polished floor. No visible supports or attachments beyond their own legs.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: A large green leafy plant in a beige pot located on the far right, near the windows. It adds a natural element to the modern interior. The pot rests directly on the floor. No visible supports or attachments beyond its own base.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000045", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
